[PATH:empirical] Longitudinal case study of AI-domain scientist collaborations in North American research labs, employing ethnographic methods (e.g., interaction recording, self-report surveys of knowledge overlap, and throughput estimation via task completion rates or communication event counts). — Captures real-world dynamics and temporal variation in asymmetry and throughput under the specified geographic and interaction conditions, enabling assessment of whether the 0.4 Gini threshold is ecologically valid and replicable.
